title: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sents.t: Laura Honeken posted the following video after capturing footage of something creepy on her baby monitor.
sents.zh: Laura Honeken 在婴儿监视器上拍到诡异的画面后，发布了下面这段视频。

sents.t: Her daughter is resting in her crib when Laura all of a sudden gets a bad feeling.
sents.zh: 她女儿正在婴儿床里休息，Laura 突然有种不好的预感。

sents.t: She promptly runs to her daughter's room and sees that she's okay.
sents.zh: 她立刻跑到女儿房间，看到女儿没事。

sents.t: But little does she know that something was captured on her baby monitor before she had entered the room.
sents.zh: 但她不知道，在她进房间之前，婴儿监视器已经拍到了什么。

sents.t: It's worth mentioning that no one was upstairs at the time of this recording.
sents.zh: 值得一提的是，拍摄时楼上没有任何人。

sents.t: Laura writes, "I'm terrified."
sents.zh: Laura 写道：“我吓坏了。”

sents.t: This is what was caught.
sents.zh: 这就是拍到的画面。

sents.t: It appears that a pair of legs were caught on camera.
sents.zh: 镜头里好像拍到了一双腿。

sents.t: Here's a follow-up video Laura had made in response to this creepy footage.
sents.zh: 这是 Laura 针对这段诡异画面拍的后续视频。

sents.t: There was legs that were walking. It looked like legs that were walking out of her room.
sents.zh: 有腿在走。看起来像是一双腿从她房间里走出来。

sents.t: And her window is locked. There's no other entrance to that room, literally.
sents.zh: 而且她的窗户是锁着的。那个房间真的没有别的入口。

sents.t: And you've never seen nothing going in. It just was legs going out.
sents.zh: 你也从来没看到有东西进去，只看到腿走出来。

sents.t: You see me come in, come out, and then you see those legs go out, and then you see me come upstairs to get her and go out.
sents.zh: 你能看到我进来、出去，然后看到那双腿走出去，再然后看到我上楼把她抱出去。

sents.t: Laura doesn't know what to make of this.
sents.zh: Laura 不知道该怎么解释这件事。

sents.t: What's strange about this is that whoever or whatever this was appears to have come out of nowhere, as no signs of entry were seen in the daughter's room.
sents.zh: 奇怪的是，不管这是谁或是什么，它好像是凭空出现的，因为女儿的房间里没有任何进入的迹象。

sents.t: It could be that a squatter was hiding in the house, given the fact that most squatters tend to hide in places like the attic.
sents.zh: 也可能是有人偷偷藏在房子里，毕竟这种人大多喜欢躲在阁楼之类的地方。

sents.t: Perhaps that's where they came from.
sents.zh: 也许它就是从那里来的。

sents.t: But of course, I'll leave it to you to figure this one out.
sents.zh: 当然，这件事就交给你来琢磨了。

sents.t: Was a ghost caught on camera, or had something else been captured?
sents.zh: 是镜头拍到了鬼，还是拍到了别的东西？

sents.t: Rewatch the clip and decide for yourself.
sents.zh: 重看一遍片段，自己判断吧。
